name: Zetrix AI Berhad
overview: Zetrix AI 今年通过收购 MYEG Ventures Inc. 的股权（涉及菲律宾业务）扩大区域布局，并与 Forefront Tech Holdings Acquisition Corp 及深圳数据交易所签订谅解备忘录探索新合作；同时公司因未支付 RM25M 回教债券款项被下调评级，并面临政府就 RM314M JPJ 欠款提出的诉讼。
overview_en: Zetrix AI expanded its regional footprint this year by acquiring equity in MYEG Ventures Inc. (involving Philippine operations), and entered into MOUs with Forefront Tech Holdings Acquisition Corp and Shenzhen Data Exchange Co. Ltd. to explore new collaborations; meanwhile, the company was downgraded over unpaid RM25M sukuk and faces a government lawsuit over RM314M JPJ arrears.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 公司层面推进对 MYEG Ventures 的收购及多项战略合作备忘录，同时面临债务与诉讼事项。
segments.note_en: At the company level, it pursued the acquisition of MYEG Ventures and several strategic MOUs, while facing debt and litigation matters.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 与 IPVG Employees, Inc. 双方同意将上述收购的完成期限延长至 2026 年第四季度末。
actions.text_en: Both parties mutually agreed to extend the completion timeframe of the above acquisition to the end of the fourth quarter of 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 与 IPVG Employees, Inc. 签订股份购买协议，以 RM130.0 million 收购 MYEG Ventures Inc. 的 15,253,893 股普通股。
actions.text_en: Entered into a Share Purchase Agreement with IPVG Employees, Inc. to acquire 15,253,893 ordinary shares in MYEG Ventures Inc. for RM130.0 million.

actions.title: Share Purchase Agreement entered between the Company and Next Lion Limited
actions.text: 就向 Next Lion Limited 收购 MYEG Ventures 股份的股份购买协议回复交易所询问，说明交易后 MYEG Philippines 将成为子公司。
actions.text_en: Responded to Bursa queries on the Share Purchase Agreement with Next Lion Limited for the acquisition of MYEG Ventures shares, clarifying that MYEG Philippines will become a subsidiary after the transaction.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与在 NASDAQ 上市的 Forefront Tech Holdings Acquisition Corp 签订谅解备忘录，探讨潜在业务合并。
actions.text_en: Entered into an MOU with NASDAQ-listed Forefront Tech Holdings Acquisition Corp for a potential business combination.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与深圳数据交易所签订谅解备忘录，拟共同建立平台以推动数据资产在东盟与中国的货币化及有序流动。
actions.text_en: Entered into an MOU with Shenzhen Data Exchange Co. Ltd. to jointly establish a platform to secure the monetisation of data as a strategic asset class in ASEAN and enable the orderly movement of data products between the region and China.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 通过收购 MYEG Ventures Inc. 股权，将菲律宾业务（MYEG Philippines）纳入集团，扩大区域业务版图。
model_changes.text_en: Through the acquisition of equity in MYEG Ventures Inc., the Philippine operations (MYEG Philippines) will be brought into the group, expanding its regional business footprint.

model_changes.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
model_changes.text: 与 NASDAQ 上市的 SPAC 签订谅解备忘录，探讨潜在业务合并，可能涉及上市架构或业务组合的变化。
model_changes.text_en: Entered into an MOU with a NASDAQ-listed SPAC for a potential business combination, which may involve changes to the listing structure or business portfolio.
